meta.title: Cleanup styled-components in *.stories.tsx files and convert to CSS modules
meta.body_summary: Remove all styled-components imports from story files and convert them to CSS modules, eliminating runtime CSS-in-JS generation for story components.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot converted story files from styled-components to CSS modules; two rounds of CHANGES_REQUESTED for design corrections; merged after approvals and manual testing.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1354 changed lines but with many secondary files from a merge commit, the core change is a moderate-sized frontend refactor affecting 8 story files. It fits a typical incremental migration task that underwent multiple review iterations and merged successfully.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewers requested removal of CSS layers, replacement of Box with div, correction of duplicate className, removal of spurious overflow:hidden, and proper handling of maxWidth style; also questioned inline style for global theme.
review_details.performance_claim: No runtime CSS-in-JS generation for story components, improving performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot demonstrated ability to refactor multiple story files to CSS modules, respond to nuanced design feedback (CSS layers, component usage), and adapt to codebase conventions; merge required human guidance on style details.

detection_detail.code_reading: Jonrohan and francine reviewed CSS changes for consistency, demanded removal of CSS layers and use of div over Box; joshblack questioned global style migration approach.
detection_detail.ci_auto: size-limit report showed no bundle size change.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark data; visual rendering verified via Storybook previews, but no performance metrics provided.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Two rounds of CHANGES_REQUESTED led to removal of CSS layers, correction of duplicate className, removal of overflow: hidden, and proper handling of maxWidth in ErsatzOverlay; global style migration was updated to :global.

core_change_summary.description: Removed styled-components imports from 8 story files and replaced them with CSS modules. Created 7 new CSS module files with corresponding styles, using CSS custom properties for theming. Migrated dynamic styled props like maxWidth to CSS custom properties and conditional styles.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The merge commit from main introduced many unrelated changes (docs, test snapshots, etc.) that inflated file count but are not part of the CSS modules migration.
change_trajectory: Replace styled-components with CSS modules in ActionList, ActionMenu, and LabelGroup stories.
Complete styled-components cleanup in all remaining story files.
Remove CSS layers and replace Box components with div elements (review feedback).
Maintainer refactored CSS styles for consistency.
Fix duplicate className, overflow issue, and comment formatting (review feedback).
Merge main and fix ErsatzOverlay maxWidth style conditional.
Revert maxWidth fix, restore conditional approach per review.
Convert ThemeProvider inline style to CSS modules with :global.

review_signals.summary: Requested removal of @layer declarations from CSS modules and using div instead of Box when no sx/as props.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot removed layers and replaced Box with div in follow-up commit.

review_signals.summary: Flagged duplicate className (clsx(classes.ErsatzOverlay, maxWidth && classes.ErsatzOverlay)) and pointed out overflow:hidden not present in original.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot fixed duplicate and removed overflow property.

review_signals.summary: Suggested setting style to 'none' when maxWidth absent, leading to further refinement.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot initially set always, then reverted to conditional after jonrohan concern about style='none'.

review_signals.summary: Questioned if style='none' would be valid, prompting revert.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reverted commit and restored conditional style setting.

review_signals.summary: Suggested using :global in CSS modules for global styles instead of inline <style>.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot converted to CSS modules using :global.
